description: Create a new coupon with discount configuration.

amountOff.description: Fixed amount discount in smallest currency unit. Mutually exclusive with percentOff

code.description: Coupon code that customers enter to apply the discount

durationInMonths.description: Number of months the coupon applies when duration is 'repeating'

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be redeemed

percentOff.description: Percentage discount (0-100). Mutually exclusive with amountOff

productIds.description: Array of product IDs the coupon applies to

name: crm_create_coupon
